newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish near the daily highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish near the daily highs.

text.p: Sept 16 - U.S. debt futures finished near the day's highs due to short-covering. Dec T-bonds rose to 108-28/32, near its daily high of 108-29/32. Dec failed to test Friday's high of 109-00 in lighter-than-average volume. Decline in commodities, coupled with decent bill auction supported bonds, Euros. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
